desc: Ideation: identified parity-in-subsequence issue, two-layer DP formulation, product cap at limit+1, k-range early exit, zero handling, non-empty requirement.

Compute the offset for alternating sums: total = sum(nums); alternating sums range in [-total, total]; use offset = total for array indexing (size 2*total+1). (folded into dict-based approach — offset not needed with dicts)
Initialize DP structure and parity handling — resolved: two layers even/odd, seed length-1 subsequences directly.
Implement transition rules including x=0 and product cap — resolved in design; to be written in code.
Use sparse structure (dict of sets) for efficiency — decided.
Implement the complete solution in the starter code (two-layer dict-of-sets DP, seeding, transitions, final max-product query, edge cases) and verify against the three examples.

Verify the DP solution against all three examples and edge cases (empty subsequence exclusion when k=0, zero values, overflow capping with subsequent zero multiplication, k out of range), and stress-check performance on worst-case input (150 elements of value 12, limit 5000); fix any issues found.
